title: Smart Model Routing & Token Optimization
description: Implement intelligent model selection to maximize token efficiency. Route simple stories to Haiku (£0.10), medium to Sonnet (£0.40), complex to Opus (£2.00). This optimization could reduce costs by 30-40% while maintaining quality.
problem: Currently all stories use Sonnet regardless of complexity
Simple stories (docs, config, tests) waste tokens on expensive model
No mechanism to automatically select cost-appropriate model
Users hitting monthly limits faster than necessary
solution: Add complexity-based model routing to fade run
Add model selection heuristics (doc changes → Haiku)
Display estimated cost savings in output

technicalNotes.fallback: Default to Sonnet if routing uncertain

userStories.title: Complexity-Based Model Selection
userStories.story: As a FADE user, I want stories to automatically use the most cost-effective model so I maximize throughput per dollar
acceptanceCriteria: Read 'complexity' field from PRD story JSON
Route: simple → haiku, medium → sonnet, complex/high → opus
Default to sonnet if complexity field missing
Log model selection: 'Using haiku for US-003 (complexity: simple, estimated cost: £0.08)'
Support --model flag to override: fade run --model haiku

userStories.title: Story Type Heuristics
userStories.story: As FADE, I want to detect story types that benefit from cheap models so I reduce costs automatically
acceptanceCriteria: Detect documentation stories (keywords: README, docs/, comments, documentation)
Detect config stories (keywords: config, .env, settings, parameters)
Detect test-only stories (keywords: test, spec, unit test, integration test)
Detect simple refactors (keywords: rename, typo, formatting, lint)
Auto-suggest Haiku for these types even if complexity=medium
Display: 'Story appears to be documentation → suggesting Haiku (override with --model sonnet)'

userStories.title: Cost Estimation Display
userStories.story: As a user, I want to see estimated cost per story so I understand my spending
acceptanceCriteria: Before starting story, display: 'Estimated cost: £0.35 (Sonnet, ~60K tokens)'
After completing story, display: 'Actual cost: £0.42 (used 72K tokens)'
Display cumulative session cost: 'Session total: £2.10 (5 stories)'
Display savings from optimization: 'Saved £0.80 vs all-Sonnet (28% reduction)'
Show model distribution: 'Session: 2 Haiku, 3 Sonnet, 0 Opus'

technicalNotes.tokenTracking: Track input/output tokens per iteration (Claude API provides this)
technicalNotes.costCalculation: Use current model pricing (Haiku: $0.80/$4.00, Sonnet: $3/$15, Opus: $15/$75 per 1M tokens)

userStories.title: Model Override Flag
userStories.story: As a user, I want to override automatic model selection so I have control when needed
acceptanceCriteria: Support: fade run --model haiku (force Haiku)
Support: fade run --model sonnet (force Sonnet)
Support: fade run --model opus (force Opus)
Support: fade run --auto-model (use intelligent routing, default)
Display warning if override seems suboptimal: 'Warning: Using Opus for simple story (estimated £1.50 vs £0.08 with Haiku)'
Save override preference for session: 'Using --model haiku for all remaining stories in session'

userStories.title: Environment Variable Support
userStories.story: As a user, I want to set default model preference so I don't repeat --model flag
acceptanceCriteria: Support FADE_MODEL environment variable: export FADE_MODEL=haiku
Precedence: --model flag > FADE_MODEL env > auto-routing
Display active model source: 'Using Haiku (source: FADE_MODEL env variable)'
Document in README and help text
Support 'auto' value: export FADE_MODEL=auto (use intelligent routing)

technicalNotes.implementation: Check FADE_MODEL early in cmd_run(), before model selection logic

userStories.title: Documentation & Guidelines
userStories.story: As a user, I want clear guidelines on when to use each model so I make informed choices
acceptanceCriteria: Create fade/docs/model-selection-guide.md with decision matrix
Document: Haiku use cases (docs, config, tests, simple refactors)
Document: Sonnet use cases (business logic, APIs, moderate complexity)
Document: Opus use cases (architecture, algorithms, critical code)
Include cost comparison table and examples
Add to FADE.md: 'See fade/docs/model-selection-guide.md for model selection guidelines'

userStories.title: Telemetry & Analytics
userStories.story: As a developer, I want to track model usage patterns so I can measure optimization impact
acceptanceCriteria: Log to events.jsonl: model used, tokens consumed, estimated cost per story
Add to fade metrics: breakdown by model (haiku: 30%, sonnet: 60%, opus: 10%)
Track savings: 'Month to date: £45.20 spent, £18.30 saved vs all-Sonnet (29% reduction)'
Display in fade status: 'Token efficiency: 142% (28% cost reduction this month)'
Respect FADE_TELEMETRY=1 flag (only log if enabled)

userStories.title: Optimization Warnings
userStories.story: As FADE, I want to warn users about suboptimal model choices so they can improve efficiency
acceptanceCriteria: Warn if using Sonnet for obvious Haiku work: 'Consider --model haiku for this documentation story (save ~75%)'
Warn if using Haiku for complex work: 'Warning: Haiku may struggle with this algorithm. Consider --model sonnet'
Track retry patterns: If Haiku fails and retries with Sonnet, log for learning
Suggest complexity field updates: 'Story completed with Opus but marked medium → consider complexity: high'
Display optimization tips at session end: '3 stories could have used Haiku (potential £0.60 savings)'

technicalNotes.learning: Track which stories succeeded/failed with which models → improve heuristics over time

definitionOfDone: Complexity-based routing works for all complexity values
Story type heuristics detect doc/config/test stories
Cost estimation displays before and after each story
Telemetry tracks model usage and savings
All 8 user stories pass acceptance criteria

risks.risk: Haiku may fail on stories marked simple but actually complex
risks.mitigation: Provide clear override mechanism. Track failures and improve heuristics.

risks.risk: Cost estimation may be inaccurate due to token count variability
risks.mitigation: Use conservative estimates. Display as 'estimated' not 'actual'. Measure actual from API.
